answer: Locks are entered in forge, expire in umber, and mesa lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 65 aliases therefore needs 141 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3066 identities would post 1874 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
